title: psidium minense
intro: Psidium minense, commonly known as Guinep or Mamoncillo, is a tropical fruit-bearing tree native to the Americas. The health benefits of Psidium minense include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in treating gastrointestinal issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Psidium minense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
